ety.text: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *urędъ. Compare with Czech úřad, Slovak úrad, Polish urząd, Serbo-Croatian úred.
Borrowed from French châssis. Ultimately from Latin capsa. Doublet of ка́псула (kápsula), ка́псюль (kápsjulʹ), ка́сса (kássa), and кассе́та (kasséta).

ety.text: Borrowed from German Staat (“state, country”), from Middle Low German stāt, from Middle Dutch staet, from Latin stātus. The semantic development was influenced by French état from the same Latin source.
